spanish.enabled_note: The one switch for the Castilian Spanish voice, on by owner decision. false leaves it out entirely: build-native.ts neither converts nor bundles the GGUF, the manifest has no voices.es, consumer.gradle requires it absent and verify-voice-product-release.ts requires the catalog not to list it.

spanish.release_status: The release says human_approval PENDING and commercial_distribution BLOCKED (provenance.json, release-manifest.json); its NOTICE.md says voice consent and provenance for em_alex are not independently established.
